correctness.rationale: Every unsafe speed arc is replaced without loss by a rational center with reduced denominator. For δ≤1/(n+1), denominator difference bounds preserve endpoint ordering, so adjacent Farey gaps alone determine uncovered lengths. The ordered Farey-neighbor denominator bijection proves the formula for every n and real δ. Coprime constructions prove exactly the kink set, with all boundary and parity cases. Totient and final-segment formulas follow by endpoint counting and reciprocal decomposition. Exact-rational tests of 480 configurations give finite corroboration but are not used for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full-threshold exact Farey gap profile, complete kink set with an even-n missing index, and totient benchmark are not asserted or implied by inspected 2026 studies of uniform bounds, mixed two-speed thresholds or single-speed deletions. The 2024 rational-window theory fixes interval width instead of dividing radius by each denominator. Actual precise semantic and text queries did not identify an equivalent result. The gap identity is a classical-consequence calculation, so implicit earlier coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: Older Farey-neighbor / weighted covering papers could implicitly contain the same exact formula even without mentioning lonely runners.
Semantic and web search are incomplete; inaccessible or unindexed papers could overlap.
No independent human mathematical audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The exact threshold distribution for a canonical family is a motivated refinement of the recently studied uncovered-time measure. The parity anomaly in slope changes, sharp totient benchmark and φ(n+1) terminal components are natural nontrivial quantitative invariants valid for all n, rather than arbitrary numerical slices. It does not claim to solve the universal Lonely Runner Conjecture.
